description: Alpha & Omega Semi AO3401A — P-channel MOSFET, 30 V, 4 A continuous in SOT-23. Logic-level Vgs(th) -0.4 to -1.0 V — drives directly from a 3.3 V GPIO. The universal high-side load switch and reverse-polarity-protection PFET for maker projects. P-channel complement to AO3400A.
name: ao3401a
watch_out_for: PFET conducts when Vgs is negative (gate below source). High-side load switch: source to Vin, drain to load, 10-100 kΩ from gate to source, pull gate LOW with an NFET or open-drain GPIO to enable. Reverse-polarity protection: source to BAT+, drain to load, gate to GND — the body diode initially conducts on correct polarity then the channel takes over for low Vds. 4 A is the SOT-23 thermal limit; for more current step up to AO3415 or PMV20XPER. N-channel complement is AO3400A.
